text:
nina_cs: FYI — NovaCare's platform team just dropped a note: they want to onboard two new product teams (patient search + live-insights) next month. This will shift them from ~3k req/day to ~25k/day over 6 weeks.
omar_se: Whoa, that's a big jump. Are they expecting streaming tokens or short-response embeddings?
jess_ae: It's mixed. Search team wants dense embeddings at ingestion (real-time upserts), live-insights wants streaming summarization with low tail latency for clinician UI. They emphasized sub-200ms p95 for UI calls.
eng-sre-bot: Auto-alert: customer NovaCare projected 8x ingestion QPS growth. Recommend: pre-warm dedicated pods or reserved burst. Also check embedding compute profile (fp16 vs int8).
leo_csm: Renewal in 2.5 months. This could be a good expansion ARR if we lock committed pods. But if latency slips they might consider moving to another provider. Need frictionless plan + enablement.
maya_onboard: I'll prepare a 30-45m enablement session focused on streaming SDK usage, backpressure handling, and embedding upsert best practices. Can run in two weeks.
omar_se: Ops checklist: sample payloads, typical seq_len distribution, and a short perf harness. Ask them for a 24h representative trace.
jess_ae: I'll request traces and a few example docs. Also proposing an initial canary: 5% traffic to Dedicated variant (quantized), run evals on 1k summaries for quality drift.
leo_csm: Pricing note: two options — (A) hosted with committed burst credits + optimized batching and KV cache (lower sticker, higher per-token), (B) Dedicated small cluster (3 pods) with reserved pricing. I'll draft both and send to nina.
ina_cs: Can we also surface an SLO addendum for tail latency? They asked for p95 and p99 guarantees.
eng-sre-bot: SLO addendum templates available: /templates/slo-addendum.md. Recommending p95 target 180ms, p99 target 450ms for streaming calls.
maya_onboard: Workshop will include a short eval notebook, sample client retry logic and a prompt set. Quick retry snippet for clients: ```python
# exponential backoff for stream reads
import time
def backoff(retries):
    time.sleep(min(2 ** retries * 0.1, 2))
```
jess_ae: Also remind them to pin model revisions during rollouts. We'll do a canary traffic split 5% -> 25% -> 100% with quality gates.
omar_se: SRE: can we reserve two pods for a perf window next Tue? We need to run the harness and a 2hr soak.
eng-sre-bot: Reservation OK pending capacity check. Preliminary delta: +2 pods for 48h adds 240 GPU-hours. Estimated approval time: 4h.
leo_csm: Great. Nina, I'll include a renewal touchpoint and a short exec summary of expansion ROI + cost delta.
nina_cs: Thanks. Action items: 1) Jess request traces (today), 2) Leo draft pricing (tomorrow), 3) Maya schedule workshop (Tues/Wed), 4) Omar coordinate perf window with SRE (today).
eng-sre-bot: Noted. Creating ticket NC-452 in tracker and attaching reservation stub.
nina_cs: Adding a note: capture qualitative feedback after workshop — ask their product leads: impact on clinician workflow, any tradeoffs they saw.
leo_csm: We'll aim to convert to Dedicated before renewal if their OKRs align.
maya_onboard: I'll prepare slides and a short checklist for the engineers.
eng-sre-bot: Closing loop: capacity estimate posted on ticket NC-452.
nina_cs: Thanks team :handshake:
